spotlights.name: Get equivalently better with less precision
spotlights.tagline: PEFT methods — LoRA & QLoRA — reproduced from scratch · COMP 433
spotlights.description: Two-person deep-learning research project: instead of trusting the papers' numbers, we reimplemented parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods from scratch and benchmarked them on a single RTX 3090.
bullets: Implemented LoRA adapters by hand — modifying Q/K/V projections in PyTorch — and QLoRA (4-bit NF4) for single-GPU fine-tuning of GPT-Neo and Qwen2.5.
Benchmarked accuracy, F1, and VRAM across SST-2, SQuAD v1.1, Wikitext-2, and AlpacaEval — rank-8 LoRA cut GPT-2 perplexity from 54.3 to 31.6.
Full research writeup: proposal, progress report, and final report with training-loss analysis.

spotlights.name: PlayLocal
spotlights.tagline: Location-based platform for organizing local pickup sports
spotlights.description: Find a game nearby, see who's in, and actually show up. Team capstone built production-shaped: quality gates, coverage tracking, and a real deploy pipeline. I led backend and release engineering across 108 commits.
bullets: Spring Boot backend: auth profiles, Flyway DB migrations, transactional email (Brevo), and CI test configuration.
Reviewed and merged feature work from an AI assistant with knowledge-grounded, user-aware answers to weather forecasts for upcoming games.
Production pipeline: SonarCloud quality gate + Codecov, deployed on Netlify and Render with Neon Postgres.
